_doc: A2 World 6 props. Frame units, 2 units = 1 world px (sprites drawn at scale 0.25). bell_buoy*: 64 x 96, its float's crest ("water") on the lake line; "bell" the bell (the toll ring), "light" the lantern. vigil_candle_*: 64 x 64, "foot" on the floor, "flame" the wick tip (a live flame and the light go there). grasp_hand: 64 x 160 (32 x 80 px), two hands filling the grasp's 28 x 80 px hurt rect ("hurt", units), the highest fingertip at "tips", its bottom "base" on the water line when fully risen (show only what is above the line). buoy_lantern_*: v2's lantern_post frame (64 x 96, "foot" on the floor, "flame" the light), its cork float at "water". altar_hush*, bell_hush*: v2's altar and bell frames. sconce_dead: v2's sconce frame (no flame, no light). eye_seal_*: 128 x 192 over the two-by-three doorway boss_arena.gd seals.
